title: Frontiers: The Persuasive Effect of Fox News: Noncompliance with Social Distancing During the COVID-19 Pandemic
authors: Andrey Simonov; Szymon Sacher; Jean‐Pierre Dubé; Shirsho Biswas
eligible_reason: Fox News viewership and COVID social distancing: zip-level distancing regressed on continuous viewership instrumented by cable channel position (cross-section, repeated cross-section and panel IV with channel-position x period slopes). Continuous treatment and IV, no staggered binary adoption.
design_notes: MktSciReplicationFakeData/4_panel_OLS.R and 5_panel_IV.R: feols(depvar ~ rating | STATE^timePeriod + zip + timePeriod[n_channels] + ...); 8_firststage.R: rating_pct ~ ordinal_position.
data_files_note: README.docx: NLTV/Focus and SafeGraph variables randomly shuffled with replacement (no correlations preserved); file reduced to zip codes in 5 random states and every 4th day.
data_provenance_note: Embargoed variables scrambled by random shuffling; excluded under 5b.
